name: Hosah
title: Levitical Gatekeeper
summary: Hosah was a Levite from the family of Merari who served as a gatekeeper at the house of the Lord during King David's time. He was appointed to guard the western gate and the Shalleketh gate. He was a faithful servant in temple service and organized his sons for gatekeeping duties.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as Gatekeeper
keyEvents.description: Hosah was appointed among the Levites to serve as a gatekeeper at the house of the Lord during David's organization of temple service.

keyEvents.title: Service at the Western Gate
keyEvents.description: Hosah was appointed in charge of the western gate of the temple, along with Shuppim, at the Shalleketh Gate on the road that goes up.

keyEvents.title: Casting Lots for the Gatekeepers
keyEvents.description: Hosah and the other gatekeepers cast lots for their guard duties, both small and large, according to their families, for each gate.

keyEvents.title: Shimri Appointed as Head
keyEvents.description: Although Shimri was not the firstborn, Hosah appointed him as head among his sons, demonstrating the father's sovereign choice in organizing the service.

keyEvents.title: Hosah's Sons in Service
keyEvents.description: Hosah's sons and brothers totaled thirteen men who served in the gatekeeping duty at the temple.
